changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Pin PRS fixed reports to table-friendly ADS dbt models for Copilot previews.
changeSet.sql: WITH mapping(template_code, primary_model) AS ( VALUES ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-OVERVIEW', 'public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_overview'), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-LEASE-EXECUTION', 'public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_lease_summary'), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-FINANCE-COST', 'public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_finance_cost'), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-CURING-WORKLOAD', 'public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_curing_workload'), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-PENDING-APPROVAL', 'public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_pending'), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-PROJECT-CUSTOMER', 'public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_project_customer'), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-CHANGE-BOARD', 'public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_change_log'), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-RECOVERY-BOARD', 'public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_recovery_detail'), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-DRILL-LEASE-DETAIL', 'public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_lease_detail'), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-DRILL-CHANGE-DETAIL', 'public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_change_log'), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-DRILL-RECOVERY-DETAIL', 'public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_recovery_detail'), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-DRILL-AUDIT-TRAIL', 'public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_audit_trail') ) UPDATE analytics_report_template t SET spec_json = jsonb_set( COALESCE(NULLIF(t.spec_json, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), '{queryContract,primaryDbtModel}', to_jsonb(m.primary_model::text), true )::text, metric_definition_json = jsonb_set( COALESCE(NULLIF(t.metric_definition_json, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), '{primaryDbtModel}', to_jsonb(m.primary_model::text), true )::text, updated_at = ${now} FROM mapping m WHERE t.template_code = m.template_code AND t.archived = false;
